undertaking.Title: Mission
undertaking.Text: To commit to the future of the boys and girls of La Esmeralda rural area, through pedagogical actions in educational processes such as language, mathematics, arts, physical education, among others; seeking inclusion, providing them with protection, prevention mechanisms, and acceleration of their cognitive processes.

sight.Title: Vision
sight.Text: We seek to be recognized nationally and internationally as an institution that has applied strategies as a personalized initiative from student to student, generating changes and transformations in their study habits and stimulating educational processes that help the development and growth of boys and girls in all their dimensions (physical, emotional, cognitive, social, ethical, etc.).

Contact.Title: Contact Us
Contact.Text: Do not hesitate to get in touch with us if you want to learn more about our work supporting children and young people in vulnerable situations academically. We are available to answer your questions, tell you how you can be part of this solidarity cause, or provide you with information if you know a child or young person who could benefit from our academic support.

Faq.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.Text: Thank you for considering making a donation to Fundación CMA. Here you will find answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about how to support our educational mission.

FirstQuestion.question: How will my donation be used?
FirstQuestion.answer: Every donation directly supports educational programs, school supplies, learning resources, and community initiatives that benefit the children and young people served by Fundación CMA.

SecondQuestion.question: Is my donation secure?
SecondQuestion.answer: Yes. We use trusted payment providers to ensure that every donation is processed securely and that your personal information remains protected.

ThirdQuestion.question: Can I make a monthly donation?
ThirdQuestion.answer: Of course. Monthly donations provide us with consistent support that allows us to plan long-term educational projects and generate lasting impact in our community.

FourthQuestion.question: Can I cancel my monthly donation?
FourthQuestion.answer: Yes. You can modify or cancel your recurring donation at any time by contacting our team or through your payment provider.

FivethQuestion.question: Will I receive a donation receipt?
FivethQuestion.answer: Yes. Once your donation is completed, you will receive a confirmation email and a receipt for your records.

SixthQuestion.question: Why support Fundación CMA?
SixthQuestion.answer: Your generosity helps provide children and young people with access to education, academic support, school materials, and opportunities that allow them to build a better future.

Example1.title: Equitable education
Example1.description: Your support provides children and young people with access to quality education, personalized academic guidance, and learning opportunities that help them build a better future.

Example2.title: Community support
Example2.description: Donations allow us to create safe and welcoming spaces where children and families receive guidance, emotional support, and opportunities to grow together as a community.

Example3.title: Educational resources
Example3.description: Every contribution helps provide school supplies, educational resources, technology, and learning environments that inspire students to reach their full potential.
